page.overview:
What is Hierro Cave?

Hierro Cave is a location in Final Fantasy Dimensions. It's located to the east of Ashmonte. It's a mining location. People in Fabrica mine raw ore here and make them in to all kinds of things.

This cave was blocked by the imperial soldiers before the Warriors of Light find Argy inside Ashmonte. On their quest, the Warriors travel through this place to reach Fabrica.
